messages:
chen: pushed a canary of borealis-30b-int4v3 to the canary pool. quick sanity runs look fine < 32k but long-prefill tests (48k+) show divergence and occasional kv-cache length reported as 32768 even though seq=51200. attaching repro command

maya: where are the logs? any repro script?

chen: repro command i used:
```bash
./run_canary.sh --model=borealis-30b-int4v3 --mode=prefill --seq_len=51200 --prefill_len=48000 --quant=int4v3 --run-id=canary-3487
```
logs snippet shows token mismatch at step ~48012 and a kv index read that clamps to 32768.

sanjay: ran that command on my devbox (A100) and hit the same mismatch around 48010-48020. probability delta ~0.7% across several tokens, not just end-of-stream. pasted minimal stack-ish trace below:
```
kv_write: idx=48012 -> stored_pos=32768
kv_read: requested_pos=48012 -> served_pos=32768
failure: rotary_phase_apply: pos_mismatch -> fallback to float path
```

oliver: quick hypothesis: rotary index scaling / ropemap in our int4 fast-kernel uses a 16-bit accumulator or an index mask that was meant for 32k windows. when token index > 32768 we might wrap or clamp. the float path uses 32/64-bit indices so it doesn't hit this. looks like quantized kernel not accounting for extended windows.

chen: also seeing a small codepath where we convert global token idx -> local shard idx with `& 0x7FFF` in one helper (should've been 0xFFFFFFFF on 32-bit builds). that would explain clamp.

maya: can someone drop a tiny unit test that forces idx > 32768 and asserts no wrap? also want an internal tracing flag for kv indices so we can dump the first bad frame.

sanjay: i pushed a quick canary patch (PR: /r/dev/3487-kv-index-assert) that adds an assertion and extra trace logging when seq_len > 32768. deploying to 1 node now. devex-bot should report.

devex-bot: Canary deployment to pool-canary-3 succeeded. nodes=1/1, build=borealis-30b-int4v3-canary-3487. Observability: added kv.index.trace=true.

chen: thanks. attached a tiny reproducer we can run in CI:
```python
# repro_kv_wrap.py
from runtime import Runner
r = Runner(model='borealis-30b-int4v3')
inp = 'A'*50000  # long prompt to fill >48k
out = r.generate(inp, max_new_tokens=64)
# check kv positions in r.trace.kv_positions for any < seq index
```

oliver: plan of action: 1) add widened index type in int4 kernel path (fast-kernel change) 2) add assertion + evict-fallback if we detect clamp 3) run goldset quality eval across long-context sets and compare perplexity/delta. we should also run quantized vs float diff on the same prefill to check whether quality regressions are purely positional or compounded by quant noise.

maya: i'll take 1+2. will open a PR with tests.

sanjay: i'll run the goldset eval (long-context suite) on canary and main for comparison, ETA ~45m. posting progress here.

chen: appreciated. leaving traces enabled for next 2 runs. if anyone finds a different root cause (shard boundary math, memcopy clipping) call it out. :thumbsup:
